keys.name: AGENT_FILE_RUN_API_URL
keys.purpose: HTTP and WebSocket base URL for the agent-file-run service.

keys.name: AGENT_FILE_RUN_BEARER_TOKEN
keys.purpose: Bearer credential for harness requests; a runtime getBearerToken provider may be used instead.

keys.name: AGENT_FILE_RUN_AGENT_PATH
keys.purpose: Agent path used for chat prompts.

keys.name: AGENT_SUGGESTIONS_AGENT_PATH
keys.purpose: Optional agent path used to generate suggestions.

keys.name: AGENT_CHAT_HISTORY_MAX
keys.purpose: Maximum prior user/assistant messages included in a prompt; defaults to 20.

keys.name: AGENT_FILE_RUN_OWNER_ID
keys.purpose: Static owner identity; prefer config.getOwnerId when identity changes at runtime.
